title: Simplicity Bias and OOD Generalization: Boolean-Function Sensitivity Sweep

original_idea.body:
# Boolean-Function Sensitivity Sweep

Train tiny MLPs on Boolean functions of controlled sensitivity; measure learned-function sensitivity and OOD generalization.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to OOD/goal-misgeneralization but the link to a concrete catastrophic outcome stays broad.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny MLPs on synthetic Boolean functions; classic beginner setup.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped sensitivity sweep with quantified simplicity-bias gap.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: synthetic, one GPU; though simplicity bias is well-studied.

novelty.reasoning: Boolean-function sensitivity/simplicity-bias learning is extensively studied.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Sensitivity/simplicity-bias learning of Boolean functions is well-studied.
